CustomField.description: Units consumed in the period, rollover corrected. Written by Apex, not a formula, so that an estimated read, a corrected read or a mid period meter swap can be overridden by hand and the override audited. FSD 5.10.5.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Normally calculated for you from the two readings and the register modulus. Only type over it when the provider estimated the read or the meter was swapped mid period, and say why in Chatter or a note.
CustomField.label: Consumption
